verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at developers.cloudflare.com, which hosts the Sandbox docs, so an agent can be pointed at it. A machine-readable openapi.json also returns 200. However, the per-page markdown variant of the Sandbox get-started doc returned 404, and the llms.txt shown is site-wide rather than Sandbox-specific. Missing for 10: evidence of a Sandbox-scoped llms.txt or agent-oriented docs section, working per-page markdown (.md) versions of Sandbox docs, and independent corroboration of agents using these docs.
